starting_point: On three scored folds the two expanded policies each improved by three of 3894 rows and missed the promotion rule. The additional pairwise ranking alternative also failed nomination. Test a fresh selection policy under the same budget.
hypothesis: Trials fitted on 64-80 percent of a task can rank methods differently from the final full-data fit. Use near-final training size to assess a locked shortlist while retaining the ability to keep the current choice.
algorithm: On a sufficiently large group-stratified task reserve one of eight class-preserving training folds before starting the search and reserve up to three fits. When the ordinary agent proposes stopping, nominate at most three already confirmed choices from the action menu and at most three unique learners. Train each once on the entire seven-eighths search pool. Compare their class-aligned predictions on the separate eighth. Only replace the ordinary choice if an alternative gains at least .003 overall and is nonnegative on both group-preserving halves. Give the final selection a full-task refit. Preserve normal behavior on other protocols and when resources are insufficient.
outside: Use the same five grouped folds of the anonymous 6493 rows but only the two evaluation folds (3 and 4) not scored in the previous three-fold experiment. Some of these rows were previously used to fit other models; this is training-side development on new evaluation partitions. Run three cold arms per fold: unchanged teammate catalogue at 32, compact ordinary protected exploration at 32, and near-full confirmation at 32. All branches are frozen before starting. Open both outer answers only after all six solutions and independent prediction replays are sealed.
qualification: Require no decline on either outside fold against either comparison, at least one positive fold against each, and a pooled accuracy gain of at least .003 against each. Report all paired gains and grouped uncertainty even on failure. Only a passing policy may spend one designated validation grade after freezing its full-package run. Test and H2 stay sealed.
